description: This file provides configuration helper functions for authentication, including tenant salt configuration, tenant resolution, tenant allowance checking, and JWT configuration, with exports for use in other modules.

methods.name: getTenantSaltConfig
methods.description: Returns flags about static salt configuration without exposing the value.

methods.name: getTenantConfig
methods.description: Provides strategy to resolve and allow tenants based on environment variables and request headers.

methods.name: getJwtConfig
methods.description: Provides JWT configuration parameters from environment variables.
